meta.name: render-value-prop
meta.description: Render a designed 'value prop' video from a config — 3-5 noun-phrase benefit claims (<=4 words each) revealed sequentially over per-SKU product visuals, one crisp editorial frame per claim (hook sticker -> N claim beats -> brand end card). Deterministic PIL/HTML beat renderer frame-stepped via Playwright and encoded with FFmpeg, sound-off legible, hard cuts, uniform pacing. FREE (no paid calls); music is added separately (create-music-elevenlabs). Use for the value-prop format.
